vi: vị trí còn trống (cần tuyển người)
en: A job that is available because nobody is doing it at the moment.
example: I understand you have a vacancy.

en: An official document that allows a foreigner to work in a country.
example: And because I'm not an EU national, would I need a work permit?

en: An extra thing an employer gives besides the normal pay.
example: We also offer some good fringe benefits.

vi: đặc quyền, lợi ích thêm từ công việc
en: An extra advantage you get because of your job.
example: Oh, that's a really good perk, isn't it?

vi: người giới thiệu (viết thư tham khảo cho ứng viên)
en: A person who gives information about your character and work to a possible employer.
example: And could you bring along the names of two referees?

en: The business a shop gets from its customers.
example: It's attracted a lot of custom.

vi: buổi xem trước (trước khi khai trương)
en: A chance to see something before it is open to the public.
example: I was invited to a special preview.

en: Very simple in design, with only the most basic features.
example: The whole place has been given a new minimalist look.

en: Typical of a person or company and easy to recognise as theirs.
example: The company's signature colours of black and red.

en: Available in a shop to buy now.

en: Used only for one purpose or subject.

en: A person who takes part in a competition.
example: All entrants will receive a special sports calendar.

en: A sports match that has been arranged for a particular date.
example: With details of all Bradcaster fixtures in the coming year.

en: Relating to the heart.
example: A complete review of your cardiac fitness and muscle tone.

vi: buổi hội thảo chuyên đề (ở đại học)

example: I think that having to do a seminar presentation really helped me.

vi: giờ học nhóm nhỏ với giảng viên
en: A small university class in which students discuss their work with a tutor.
example: I am not so pleased with my actual performance right now in the tutorials.

vi: từ ngữ khẩu ngữ, lối nói thông tục
en: An informal word or phrase used in everyday speech.
example: They use so many colloquialisms.

en: To say what you think openly and with confidence.
example: It's mostly because I have had no confidence to speak out.

vi: chen vào nói, xen vào cuộc thảo luận
en: To join a conversation suddenly and quickly.
example: But recently, I've been trying to speak up more, and I just jump in.

en: A magazine that publishes academic articles on a subject.
example: So I had to turn to the books and journals.

en: A book or article mentioned as a source of information.

en: Feeling annoyed because you cannot do or achieve what you want.
example: Sometimes in the English class, I felt frustrated when I had to read articles about the environment.

en: Feeling a strong wish to do something.
example: That would have helped my confidence too, and I would have been more motivated.

vi: hiện tượng mắc cạn (của cá voi, cá heo)

example: Most often die in what are known as 'mass strandings'.

en: A small animal or plant that lives on or in another and feeds from it.
example: The first is that the behaviour is linked to parasites.

vi: lây nhiễm, sống ký sinh với số lượng lớn
en: To be present in large numbers and cause damage or disease.
example: Stranded animals were infested with large numbers of parasites.

en: To find the right direction to travel.
example: Since marine animals rely heavily on their hearing to navigate.

en: A poisonous substance produced by a plant or animal.

vi: ăn vào, nuốt vào cơ thể
en: To take food or another substance into the body.

en: To find or show exactly what something is or where it is.

en: To see or understand the difference between two things.
example: Sea mammals cannot distinguish between sick and healthy leaders.

en: Certain to happen and impossible to avoid.
example: Will follow sick leaders even to an inevitable death.

en: Made by a chemical process rather than found in nature.
example: Thus making it the world's first synthetic dye.

en: A substance used to change the colour of cloth or other material.

en: Famous and highly respected, especially in a profession.

en: An important discovery or achievement that solves a problem.

en: To obtain something from a particular source.

en: A colour or a shade of a colour.

en: To lose colour or become less bright.

en: Very fashionable at a particular time.

en: To stay in the mind and cause worry or sadness for a long time.

vi: từ viết tắt (ghép từ chữ cái đầu)

vi: đứng bên bờ vực của, sắp sửa
en: Very close to a big change or discovery.
example: We may now stand poised on the brink of the answer to that question.

en: Careful and cautious, not taking risks.
example: We make a very conservative assumption that we are looking for a life form that is pretty well like us.

vi: một cách triệt để, hoàn toàn
en: In a very big and basic way.
example: Since if it differs radically from us we may well not recognize it as a life form.

en: Impossible to imagine or believe.
example: It seems inconceivable that at least one of these planets does not have a life form on it.

en: The act of noticing or finding something.

en: Connected with what is right and wrong.

en: Very dry because of a lack of water.

en: To go back to an earlier state or way of living.

vi: lưỡng cư (sống cả trên cạn lẫn dưới nước)

en: Belonging to the earliest period of the Earth's history.

en: A long structure built out into the sea where boats can stop.

vi: tiện nghi, cơ sở tiện ích
en: A useful or pleasant facility in a place.
example: After development, it became a tourist hub with various amenities.

vi: tính mềm dẻo (khả năng thích nghi của não)
en: The ability to change and adapt easily.
example: The brain demonstrates remarkable plasticity in phonetic recognition and pattern detection.

en: Connected with thinking and understanding.
example: Early bilingual exposure also enhances cognitive flexibility.

en: The ability to read and write.

vi: làm loãng, làm giảm chất lượng
en: To make something weaker or less effective.
